query:
SELECT id, COUNT(*) as qtd, MIN(saleDate) as min_data, MAX(saleDate) as max_data
FROM sales
WHERE YEAR(saleDate) = 2024 AND MONTH(saleDate) BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
LIMIT 20;
